'''Chokee & Chokee''' was an independent polling agency.

==History==
During the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the agency could report an approval rating of 81% for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] among citizens of the [[Arrowhead|Inner Core]].
This was the lowest point since the start of the conflict.

[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] used the polls to suggest the Chancellor was being tied up in bureaucratic red-tape by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], to which he received boos and jeers from the attending [[Senator/Legends|Senators]]. As an upside for the Chancellor, the same polls showed the approval rating for the Senate holding at only 31%.
